subject: Digital Electronics
questionText:
An asynchronous counter is designed using 10 FFs
having MOD No. 1000. Delay of each FF used is 8
n sec, then for which clock frequencies, counter will
work properly.
(a)
12.5 MHz
(b) 1.25 MHz
(c)
125 MHz
(d) 25 MHz
[MCQ]
explanation: Practice Question from Digital Electronics DPP-11 (Sequential Circuits (Part - 4)).
